cues.en: What are you going to do with my picture?
cues.zh: 你要拿我的照片做什么？

cues.en: I'm going to ask you towards your thumb
cues.zh: 我要让你朝大拇指的方向，

cues.en: and you make five cuts in a count.
cues.zh: 数着数切上五刀。

cues.en: You can all do this.
cues.zh: 大家都能做到这一点。

cues.en: You hold it in the other hand
cues.zh: 用另一只手拿住它，

cues.en: and you've got those lovely carrots somewhere.
cues.zh: 你手头就有那些漂亮的胡萝卜了。

cues.en: Some of the kids are leaving their veggies.
cues.zh: 有些孩子不肯吃蔬菜。

cues.en: I'm loving it.
cues.zh: 我很喜欢这个。

cues.en: When you peel a potato,
cues.zh: 削土豆皮的时候，

cues.en: it doesn't matter right handed, left handed,
cues.zh: 不管你是惯用右手还是左手，

cues.en: like a politician underhand.
cues.zh: 或者像政客那样耍阴招从下往上削。

cues.en: All you take off that potato,
cues.zh: 从土豆削下来的，

cues.en: any other fruit and vegetable
cues.zh: 以及任何其他果蔬削下来的，

cues.en: is the thin layer of skin, you've got no waste, you're doing record time.
cues.zh: 都只有薄薄的一层皮，完全不浪费，而且速度极快。

cues.en: You know when you peel a pineapple with a knife, you leave all the bits behind?
cues.zh: 你知道用刀削菠萝时，总会留下一堆菠萝眼吧？

cues.en: Use the eye, you pull the bits out of the pineapple.
cues.zh: 用这个挖孔器，就能把菠萝眼一个个挑出来。

cues.en: Use the same eye, you're going to make really good french fries.
cues.zh: 用同样的挖孔器，你还能做出超棒的薯条。

cues.en: You know why they're so good? They've got three sides, not four, that's how the French make it.
cues.zh: 知道为什么这么棒吗？因为它们有三个面而不是四个面，法国人就是这么做的。

cues.en: They use less oil, and they cook quicker.
cues.zh: 它们用油更少，熟得也更快。

cues.en: And if you want to make them taste great, you leave the skin on the potato.
cues.zh: 要是想让味道更好，就别削土豆皮。

cues.en: You don't peel it, you wash it. Cook them like that with the skin on.
cues.zh: 别削皮，洗干净就行。就带着皮这么做。

cues.en: And if you cook these yourself without trans fat,
cues.zh: 如果你自己做，不用反式脂肪，

cues.en: you wash them down with red wine, you'll never die, you'll live forever.
cues.zh: 再配上一杯红酒，你就能长命百岁，永远年轻。

cues.en: All in the other hand, it's another machine.
cues.zh: 而在另一边，是另一台机器。

cues.en: That's a mandolin slicer.
cues.zh: 这是一个曼陀林切片机。

cues.en: You let those slices go into hot oil and watch them go round.
cues.zh: 你把切好的土豆片放进热油里，看着它们翻滚。

cues.en: You're going to love the chips.
cues.zh: 你一定会爱上这种薯片的。

cues.en: You hit that bar every time and because you've got a very sharp moving blade,
cues.zh: 你每次按压那个推杆，因为有一把非常锋利的活动刀片，

cues.en: you get a clean thin slice every time. You couldn't slice a potato like that
cues.zh: 每次都能切出利落的薄片。用这种东西

cues.en: with one of these things. You'll slice cucumber for cucumber salad. It'll come
cues.zh: 你是切不出这种效果的。切黄瓜做黄瓜沙拉，

cues.en: out as soon as that. Now my machine is so gentle you'll feel asparagus without
cues.zh: 一眨眼就切好了。我的机器非常轻柔，切芦笋都不会

cues.en: breaking the tip. I know this is a carrot. You want to see how easy it will be.
cues.zh: 弄断尖头。我知道这是胡萝卜。想看看它有多好用吗。

cues.en: Look at that. You've never used a peeler sharp. I'll show you how you do this and they're yours, take a few seconds.
cues.zh: 看这个。你肯定没用过这么锋利的削皮刀。我来演示一下怎么用，马上就送给你们，只要几秒钟。

cues.en: First you peel the carrot and then you slice it. Now when you slice, you don't hold the carrot up in the air like when you peel.
cues.zh: 先给胡萝卜削皮，然后再切片。切片的时候，可别像削皮那样把胡萝卜悬空拿在手里。

cues.en: You put the carrot down on a hard surface.
cues.zh: 你要把胡萝卜放在硬台面上。

cues.en: You press harder than when you peel.
cues.zh: 下压的力道要比削皮时更重一些。

cues.en: So the slices come out twice as thick as the peel.
cues.zh: 这样切出来的厚度就是削皮的两倍。

cues.en: You slice hard Italian cheese the same way.
cues.zh: 切硬质意大利奶酪也是一样的切法。

cues.en: You can slice cheese as soon as this with a knife.
cues.zh: 用刀可切不出这么快的奶酪片。

cues.en: Now you put those slices together like a pack of playing cards.
cues.zh: 现在把切好的片像理扑克牌一样叠在一起。

cues.en: You can all do this.
cues.zh: 大家都能学会。

cues.en: You stack the one on top of the other. There's no trick, there's no skill, but you must use
cues.zh: 把它们一片片叠起来。没什么门道，也不需要技巧，但你必须用

cues.en: at least six slices. Don't take a shortcut and track with one, it won't work. You fold
cues.zh: 至少六片。别偷懒只用一片试，那样可不行。把这些片

cues.en: the slices over, hold the loose ends in one hand, you rub the machine across the top.
cues.zh: 对折起来，一手捏住散开的那端，另一手拿着刨子在顶上刮。

cues.en: Now you can really see how sharp it is. Only a very sharp knife will do this. This is a
cues.zh: 现在大家能看出来它有多快了吧。只有极锋利的刀才能做到这点。这是

cues.en: true test of sharpness, because anything less sharp will just tear it and break it.
cues.zh: 对锋利度的真正考验，因为不够锋利的刀只会把它扯烂撕碎。

cues.en: They're made in Switzerland, they're not made in China.
cues.zh: 这是瑞士制造的，不是中国制造的。

cues.en: They're made of stainless steel, they cannot rust.
cues.zh: 它们是不锈钢材质，绝不会生锈。

cues.en: And each rust is safe, and I promise you they never need sharpening.
cues.zh: 每一把都安全防锈，我向大家保证，它们永远都不需要磨刀。

cues.en: And if anyone thinks that's a special one, you could have that one and use another one.
cues.zh: 要是有人觉得我手里这把是特制的，这把归你，我换一把用。

cues.en: They're five dollars each, they're worth every penny.
cues.zh: 一把五块钱，绝对物超所值。

cues.en: They last a lifetime.
cues.zh: 一把能用一辈子。

cues.en: You get 2 for 10. You can buy 4 for 20. Do you get 1 free?
cues.zh: 10 块钱买 2 把。20 块钱能买 4 把。那会送 1 把吗？

cues.en: Now why would anybody want 5 feeders if it lasts a lifetime?
cues.zh: 如果一把能用一辈子，谁还会要 5 把削皮刀呢？

cues.en: You've got 4 friends, that's why.
cues.zh: 因为你有 4 个朋友啊，这就是原因。

cues.en: You've got Thanksgiving coming up. You've got all the holidays.
cues.zh: 感恩节快到了，各种节假日都快来了。

cues.en: You're not only saving money, you save a lot of time looking for gifts.
cues.zh: 你不光省了钱，还省了大把挑礼物的时间。

cues.en: How many? 2. That's the way to buy.
cues.zh: 要几个？两个，这就买对了。

cues.en: Let me give you a bag to put it in.
cues.zh: 我给你拿个袋子装上。

cues.en: 15 years I've been selling the same thing.
cues.zh: 这同一款东西，我卖了15年了。

cues.en: 1994, I was in the Daily Nuke.
cues.zh: 1994年，我还上过《每日新闻》。

cues.en: You only want one, you've got no friends like me.
cues.zh: 你只要一个啊，那你跟我一样没朋友。

cues.en: There you go.
cues.zh: 拿好。

15 years, selling the same thing.

cues.zh: 1994……你要两个啊。

cues.en: 1994, I was in the Daily Nuke.
cues.zh: 1994年，我还上过《每日新闻》。

cues.zh: 三年前还上了《Vanity Fair》。

cues.en: Julie Roberts had the cover on me in the middle.
cues.zh: Julia Roberts上的封面，我占了内页跨页。

cues.en: One for you.
cues.zh: 给你一个。

cues.en: The best five dollars you've ever spent.
cues.zh: 这绝对是你花得最值的5块钱。

cues.en: They're not cheap, you're not buying them because they're cheap.
cues.zh: 它们并不便宜，你买它们也不是图便宜。

cues.zh: 你买是因为它们好用。

cues.en: They're not the five. That's the way you buy them.
cues.zh: 不是那5个。买就得这么买。

cues.en: Listen, when you buy five of these and you give them away as gifts...
cues.zh: 听着，当你买了5个拿去送礼……

cues.en: They're not going to be offended because they've only got a peeler.
cues.zh: 他们不会因为只收到一把削皮刀而不高兴。

cues.en: They're going to be delighted to get the best peeler in the world.
cues.zh: 他们会为收到世界上最好的削皮刀而欣喜若狂。

cues.en: That's what it is.
cues.zh: 事实就是如此。

cues.en: And they're going to think of you every time they go in the kitchen.
cues.zh: 而且他们每次进厨房都会想起你。

cues.en: And you're giving them something they can't buy at any store.
cues.zh: 你送给他们的，是任何商店都买不到的好东西。

cues.zh: 就算你在后面买包牙签，也得花不止五块钱。

cues.zh: 一把瑞士军刀差不多要一百美元。

cues.zh: 瑞士不产便宜货，只造高品质。
